name: Trazodone
summary: A novel antidepressant of the SARI class, a serotonin antagonist and reuptake inhibitor. The drug is used medically to treat depressive and anxiety disorders and symptoms. It is reported to have anxiolytic and hypnotic effects.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

pharmacology.text: Trazodone is a mixed agonist and antagonist of various serotonin receptors, antagonist of adrenergic receptors, weak histamine H1 receptor antagonist, and weak serotonin reuptake inhibitor. More specifically, it is an antagonist of 5-HT2A and 5-HT2B receptors, a partial agonist of the 5-HT1A receptor, and an antagonist of the α1- and α2-adrenergic receptors. It is also a ligand of the 5-HT2C receptor with lower affinity than for the 5-HT2A receptor.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin antagonist and reuptake inhibitor (SARI); Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor antagonist; α1-Adrenergic receptor antagonist; Serotonin reuptake inhibitor

body.says: Trazodone (IR): 4–15 hours; Trazodone (ER): 9–13 hours; mCPP: 3–16 hours

uses.text: Trazodone is an antidepressant medication used to treat major depressive disorder, anxiety disorders, and insomnia. The medication is taken orally. Trazodone was approved for medical use in the United States in 1981.

sideEffects.text: Common side effects include dry mouth, feeling faint, vomiting, and headache. More serious side effects may include suicidal ideation, mania, irregular heart rate, and pathologically prolonged erections.
